entries.description: Public, stateless, read-only MCP Streamable HTTP service exposing the DIO/ODI Reference Model, canonical SKOS vocabulary, and selected derived Agentic ER and Policy-as-Code reference mappings. It does not inspect integrating applications, validate evidence, authorize mutations, or execute production writes.
representativeQueries: Find a canonical DIO/ODI concept and its stable identifier.
Retrieve the broader, narrower, and related SKOS concepts for a DIO/ODI term.
Find the DIO/ODI diagnostic profile for a proposed entity merge, split, or unmerge.
Retrieve the evidence-promotion and commit-boundary reference requirements for an identity-changing operation.
Check the current Reference Model, vocabulary, and application-mapping versions exposed by DIO/ODI MCP.

entries.description: The canonical DIO/ODI SKOS Reference Vocabulary, providing stable concept URIs, preferred labels, definitions, scope notes, and semantic relations. This is a SKOS vocabulary and is not presented as a completed OWL ontology.
representativeQueries: Find the canonical SKOS definition and URI for a DIO/ODI concept.
Retrieve the broader, narrower, and related concept relationships for a DIO/ODI term.
Download the canonical DIO/ODI Reference Vocabulary in Turtle format.

entries.description: An append-only, source-linked event feed documenting evidenced changes across the DIO/ODI conceptual system and its public infrastructure, including vocabulary, mappings, provenance, publications, archives, distributions, and deployments. It distinguishes event dates, scope, impact, preserved invariants, evidence, and lineage; it is not a Git commit log or proof of intervention effectiveness.
representativeQueries: Trace the documented publication and distribution history of DIO/ODI reference artifacts.
Find the evidence, scope, and preserved invariants associated with a DIO/ODI infrastructure change.
Identify recurring optimization and distribution patterns across documented DIO/ODI changes.
